cells.gaps: No share of centres registering in Citiweb is given: ONECI's 298 centres connected to City Web for registering events (CIV-042, July 2024) come with no total, and every other offices figure is of centres equipped, computerised or deployed (43.8% deployed in July 2024; more than 84% covered on 16 September 2025; 98% on 2 March 2026 with no numerator or denominator; 699 centres on 11 August 2026 with no total). How the record is made is disputed: ONECI's July 2024 statement says connected, the World Bank's newer one of 18 September 2025 says the registry is still on paper, and the newer stands. The SNECI is given no period and is not said to name the software, and the 2026 finance law's domestic line names no system.
cells.note: Stage 3 on the study's rule that a share of offices equipped places there. Not 4: no share of offices registering is given, and the newest fact on how the record is made says paper.
